history.summary: A large 1,636 sqft 4BR in D23 Bukit Panjang at $1,424 psf — roughly 7% below the project's $1,539 median, with a strong, reliable resale-only appreciation of 6.45%/yr over 93 transactions. The catch is location: only an LRT 1.2km away and OCR fringe demand cap the absolute upside and the 4BR buyer pool.
history.rating_rationale: Resale-only CAGR 6.45%/yr on a healthy 93-txn series is well above the OCR ~3.7% baseline and even the RCR ~5.8% prior — credible because it is pure resale, no new-launch bias. Asking PSF $1,424 sits ~7% under the $1,538.5 median, so there is room rather than froth. Elo 2202 / score 671 on the frontier confirms it screens well. Price $2.33M is inside the liquid band. Downside is the weak transit (Pending LRT 1.19km, no MRT) and 99LH already 12 years in.
red_flags: No MRT within walking distance — only Pending LRT 1.19km, weakest transit in this batch
4BR resale at $2.33M is a narrower family-only buyer pool
OCR D23 fringe limits absolute price ceiling vs central districts
catalysts: Distinctive 'world's largest vertical garden' branding aids resale recall and rental differentiation
Below-median asking PSF leaves headroom to the project's own resale comps
Sustained 6.45% resale CAGR shows real demand depth in Bukit Panjang for large units

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Large 4BR in OCR Bukit Panjang draws family tenants but a shallow pool; yield modest. Branding and greenery help differentiate but absolute rents are OCR-level.
